notes.title: Update v1.1.0
notes.content:
Cosmetic Shop
Use your hard earned coins to buy cosmetics for your lander! The cosmetic shop is located to your left in the main menu.

Seated Mode
You can now officially play sitting down! Check out the settings menu to adjust your seated height offset.

notes.title: Pre-Launch Update 1
notes.content:
Small patch issued to update Vive Wand bindings and fix a small UI bug.

FIXES
Fixed - Popup menu's now properly block inputs to background world menu's.

UPDATES
Updated - SteamVR Vive Wand input bindings.
